description:
Minutes of Meeting 27th Aug 2026
The meeting started at 07. 30pm.The President Vimal Joshi welcomed all members, guests,
The President in his welcome speech talked about future projects & encouraged members to participate in upcoming various district events like Impact Games, Rotel, Rodal.
President Elect Prabhudas Golla recited the 4-way test.
We introduced guests to the meeting & welcomed them to the meeting.
Rotarian Afzal Payak shared some valuable insights & addressed the attendee the impact games schedule. He also encouraged all to participate in the impact games both individual games & team games.
The meeting than shifted to introducing the guest speaker Dr Vivek Mendonsa the marketing director of Lawrence & Mayo.
He shared some tips to diversify in other business.
He spoke for approx. 50 minutes.
We thanked Dr Mendonsa for his valuable time. President adjourned the meeting at 21.30hours
